_comment: MarketHub example configuration. Copy to config.json and edit. Broker credentials (app_id, app_secret, refresh_token) are NOT configured here — they are entered in the WebUI Settings page and stored encrypted in the application database. Do NOT put app_secret / refresh_token / access_token in this file.

fyers._comment: Source definition only. No secrets. Credentials are supplied via WebUI Settings (encrypted). The Fyers feed becomes ready once credentials are configured and you complete 'Login with Fyers'.
